description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Regulations of the Finance (Levy on Short Message Services) w.e.f. 01.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of new regulations (Finance (Levy on Mobile Short Message Services) Regulations) under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018. It creates a legal framework for taxing mobile SMS advertisements, defines key terms, and specifies compliance requirements. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing regulatory/legal provisions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
